title: pandanus darwinensis var. latifructus
intro: Pandanus darwinensis var. latifructus, commonly known as a type of screw pine, is a plant species that belongs to the Pandanaceae family. This plant is rich in health benefits, including its potential to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pandanus darwinensis var. latifructus include anti-diabetic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds. Further research is needed to fully understand the bioactive constituents and therapeutic actions of this plant species.
